role: The float tag, type id 5: motion components, heal amounts, drop chances. The cross-type getters floor the value for integer reads.
scope_reason: Part of the NBT layer behind snapshots and digests.

members.name: data
members.note: Canonical text carries the 8 hex digits of the raw bits: f:+....

members.name: toString
members.note: Java's text form: built only by ItemStack.func_151000_E (the item hover in a chat line), CommandGive (chat commands are not agent input) and logging. func_151000_E runs at StatList's init on tagless stacks (id, Count, Damage: a short and a byte) and in a death message only for an item with hasDisplayName (EntityDamageSource, EntityDamageSourceIndirect, CombatTracker), and only the anvil names an item (world.conf anvil = off)

members.name: equals
members.note: NBTTagCompound.equals compares tag values only for ItemStack tags (ItemStack.areItemStackTagsEqual, isItemStackEqual) and a HoverEvent's value; no survival item's tag holds a float (ench and StoredEnchantments hold shorts, display.color an int, display.Name and Lore strings, RepairCost an int, Fireworks bytes and int arrays), so it is never compared

members.name: func_150291_c
members.note: Java truncates the float for a long read; not reached on engine data.

members.name: func_150287_d
members.note: MathHelper.floor_float for an int read; not reached.

members.name: func_150286_g
members.note: a cross-type read: NBTTagCompound.getByte/getShort/getInteger/getLong/getFloat/getDouble (and NBTTagList.func_150309_d/func_150308_e) call it only when the key holds a tag of this type but is read as another; the game reads every key with the type it wrote it (EntityLivingBase.readEntityFromNBT checks HealF/Health's type first) and a survival player writes no NBT of their own (no chat commands in the agent input; anvil, book_editing and sign_editing are off). The same-type getter runs in every recording

notes: The four floor-and-mask getters are left uncited on purpose: no native code reads a float tag as a byte/short/int/long. If a future port adds one, it must reproduce MathHelper.floor_float and the masks.
